jobs.title: Senior IBM Datacap Administrator / Developer
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior IBM Datacap Administrator / Developer based in Finland.

This is a hands-on opportunity for an experienced IBM Datacap professional to contribute to the development and evolution of an enterprise document-processing platform. The role spans Datacap development, platform administration, integrations, troubleshooting, testing, deployment, and production support. You will help transform business requirements into secure, scalable, and reliable technical solutions. Working within an Agile product engineering environment, you will collaborate across development, architecture, testing, and operations. The position offers the opportunity to build new capabilities while supporting critical enterprise workflows. Experience with modern integrations, DevSecOps practices, and secure enterprise environments will be highly valuable. This is an ideal role for someone who combines deep Datacap expertise with strong software development and problem-solving capabilities.

Accountabilities

Design, develop, configure, enhance, and maintain IBM Datacap applications, including rulesets, tasks, actions, document hierarchies, workflows, validation rules, and verification processes.
Configure and optimize OCR, document recognition, classification, data extraction, field validation, image processing, and batch-processing capabilities.
Develop reusable Datacap components and custom actions or extensions, including business rules for document routing, validation, exception handling, and processing.
Install, configure, administer, monitor, and maintain Datacap environments across Development, Test, QA, UAT, and Production.
Administer and troubleshoot Datacap Server, Rulerunner, Datacap Studio, and Datacap Navigator, including processing queues, logs, performance, failed batches, OCR issues, workflow failures, connectivity problems, and production incidents.
Participate throughout the product development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, technical design, sprint planning, development, testing, deployment, release planning, and post-deployment stabilization.
Translate business requirements and user stories into technical solutions, estimate development effort, conduct peer reviews, troubleshoot defects, and implement sustainable fixes.
Develop and support integrations using REST APIs, SOAP web services, databases, file-based interfaces, enterprise content repositories, workflow platforms, and business applications.
Integrate document-processing capabilities with enterprise platforms such as IBM FileNet P8 and IBM Content Navigator where applicable.
Manage metadata mapping, database lookups, document and metadata exports, API data exchange, retries, error handling, audit logging, and exception management.
Develop and maintain custom components using C#, .NET, Java, JavaScript, SQL, XML, REST, and SOAP, with particular emphasis on C#/.NET for custom Datacap actions and extensions.
Support secure enterprise and federal environments, including practices related to NIST, FISMA, IAM/RBAC, audit logging, vulnerability remediation, application security, PII protection, and configuration management.
Contribute to source control, CI/CD, automated deployments, release management, environment configuration, monitoring, incident management, and DevSecOps practices.

Requirements

5+ years of hands-on IBM Datacap experience, including strong experience with IBM Datacap 9.x/9.1.x.
Strong Datacap Studio development experience, along with hands-on Rulerunner administration and development.
Proven experience developing Datacap rulesets, workflows, tasks, actions, and other custom processing components.
Strong understanding of document capture and intelligent document processing, including OCR, classification, extraction, validation, verification, and image processing.
Enterprise-level Datacap administration experience across multiple environments, with strong production troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.
Experience integrating Datacap with databases and enterprise systems, including strong SQL capabilities and REST and/or SOAP integration experience.
Working knowledge of Windows Server and IIS.
Experience participating in Agile application or product development environments, from requirements and design through development, testing, deployment, and production support.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.
Experience with IBM FileNet P8 and IBM Content Navigator is highly preferred.
C#/.NET experience and a background in developing custom Datacap actions or extensions are highly valued.
Experience with Java, JavaScript, SQL Server, Oracle, or DB2 is advantageous.
Familiarity with federal government IT environments, FISMA, NIST, DevSecOps, CI/CD, enterprise application integration, and secure handling of sensitive or PII data is preferred.
Experience building and enhancing new enterprise products, rather than exclusively maintaining legacy applications, is a strong advantage.

Benefits

Remote work opportunity.
Contract engagement with an enterprise-focused technology environment.
Opportunity to work on a large-scale document-processing product with significant technical scope.
Exposure to IBM Datacap, enterprise integrations, intelligent document processing, and modern DevSecOps practices.
Opportunity to contribute across development, architecture, administration, integration, deployment, and production support.
Collaboration within an Agile product engineering environment.
Experience working with enterprise and secure federal technology environments.
Compensation and contract benefits aligned with the engagement and applicable market conditions.

jobs.location: København SV, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
We are looking for a skilled and experienced software developer with a backend focus to join our R&D team and help us develop and maintain software solutions that support internal and external tools driving our mission: decarbonizing the maritime shipping industry.

In this position, you will have a uniquely close connection to our product – the two-stroke engine – and to the customers we support.

If you want to create innovative solutions and make a real impact, we’d love to hear from you.

You will play an important role in:

Developing and enhancing scalable web applications using C#, .NET Core, Angular, SQL, and Azure
Collaborating closely with product owners and cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software
Designing modern architectures and optimize system performance, scalability, and security
Ensuring code quality and maintainability through best practices and coding standards
Troubleshoot and resolve software defects

You will start by learning our current systems and gaining insight into engine performance. Soon after, you’ll take responsibility for sub-models, supported by colleagues who share approaches, calculations, and requirements. We encourage creativity and give you the opportunity to influence content and feature implementation.

We imagine that you:

Have experience with object-oriented software development, and a solid understanding of SQL
Have strong analytical skills and ability to design robust architectures
An ability to share knowledge, collaborate with colleagues, and contribute to the development of the team
Have clear communication in English
Have experience with maintaining and developing C++ applications is an advantage
Have knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, cloud platforms (Azure or AWS)

What can you expect from us:

You will join a team of 2–3 experienced software developers together with 5 domain experts, working in an informal atmosphere with a pleasant social environment and regular social activities. You will collaborate closely with experienced and knowledgeable colleagues who are eager to share knowledge and learn from you. We work in a collaborative and innovative environment where your ideas matter and your work makes a real difference. You will have great opportunities to grow both personally and professionally, with access to all necessary training to develop your skills for current and future demands.

We support both external and internal customers with new features of varying size and complexity - sometimes with short timelines from idea to product, and other times with longer development cycles.

To get a taste of our external tools, check out: Engine selection guide & CEAS . We also maintain several internal tools supporting engine-related data, and together we take full responsibility for both backend and frontend systems.

Unleash your potential at Everllence

Join us on our journey toward a carbon‑neutral future. At Everllence, you will help shape innovative energy solutions while growing your skills and advancing your career.

We prioritize work-life balance, flexible working hours and remote work options.

We value creativity, diversity, well‑being, and have a wide range of social clubs -from yoga and fishing to creative activities.

In 2027, we will unite our Copenhagen and Holeby locations at a new and modern site in Trekroner, Roskilde.

Build your future with us

Please apply before Sunday, 11th October, 2026. Interviews will be held during the application period.

Questions? You are welcome to contact Jason James Macellaro, Manager of Systems, Simulations and Processes, Denmark at +45 28946278.

Relocating to Denmark? We support you with a mobility package, including help with CPR registration, tax, and work permits.

We aim for a fair and inclusive recruitment process. Regardless of gender, age, religion, disability, or ethnic background, we encourage you to apply. We embrace a global mindset and intercultural environment to ensure a collaborative and inclusive workplace. If you need support, such as assistive tools for dyslexia, we can assist you.

jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
Who We Are

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds in general.   

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.  

SimCorp is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.  

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

At Simcorp, we support some of the biggest financial institutions in the world to be successful by simplifying their investments, accounting, and operations. Portfolio Analysis is a product area within Simcorp’s Product Division which delivers functionality that enables clients to make investment decisions with our Front Office applications.

Portfolio Analysis consists of seven teams (of 5-8 software engineers) across several geographical locations, and we are now looking for a Student Software Engineer to join one of these teams. This is a part-time job with an expected average time of 20 hours per week with flexible working hours during exam periods.

We take pride in contributing to the growth of SimCorp with high quality work, but we also have a very pleasant way of working together where supporting each other is a big part of our relationship. Employees can meet up in SimCorp’s own very popular Friday bar and students throughout the house also meet up on a regular basis in their own community.

What You Will Be Responsible For

In your daily work you will - together with your team:

Take part in continuous improvements of tools and processes on team and individual level.
Understand requirements, discuss solutions, implement, and test the chose solutions

Most of the development is done in C#. While we have a broad range of tasks and experiments, a lot of focus is on APIs as well as on optimizing our test suite.

This is a hands-on opportunity for an experienced IBM Datacap professional to contribute to the development and evolution of an enterprise document-processing platform. The role spans Datacap development, platform administration, integrations, troubleshooting, testing, deployment, and production support. You will help transform business requirements into secure, scalable, and reliable technical solutions. Working within an Agile product engineering environment, you will collaborate across development, architecture, testing, and operations. The position offers the opportunity to build new capabilities while supporting critical enterprise workflows. Experience with modern integrations, DevSecOps practices, and secure enterprise environments will be highly valuable. This is an ideal role for someone who combines deep Datacap expertise with strong software development and problem-solving capabilities.

Accountabilities

Design, develop, configure, enhance, and maintain IBM Datacap applications, including rulesets, tasks, actions, document hierarchies, workflows, validation rules, and verification processes.
Configure and optimize OCR, document recognition, classification, data extraction, field validation, image processing, and batch-processing capabilities.
Develop reusable Datacap components and custom actions or extensions, including business rules for document routing, validation, exception handling, and processing.
Install, configure, administer, monitor, and maintain Datacap environments across Development, Test, QA, UAT, and Production.
Administer and troubleshoot Datacap Server, Rulerunner, Datacap Studio, and Datacap Navigator, including processing queues, logs, performance, failed batches, OCR issues, workflow failures, connectivity problems, and production incidents.
Participate throughout the product development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, technical design, sprint planning, development, testing, deployment, release planning, and post-deployment stabilization.
Translate business requirements and user stories into technical solutions, estimate development effort, conduct peer reviews, troubleshoot defects, and implement sustainable fixes.
Develop and support integrations using REST APIs, SOAP web services, databases, file-based interfaces, enterprise content repositories, workflow platforms, and business applications.
Integrate document-processing capabilities with enterprise platforms such as IBM FileNet P8 and IBM Content Navigator where applicable.
Manage metadata mapping, database lookups, document and metadata exports, API data exchange, retries, error handling, audit logging, and exception management.
Develop and maintain custom components using C#, .NET, Java, JavaScript, SQL, XML, REST, and SOAP, with particular emphasis on C#/.NET for custom Datacap actions and extensions.
Support secure enterprise and federal environments, including practices related to NIST, FISMA, IAM/RBAC, audit logging, vulnerability remediation, application security, PII protection, and configuration management.
Contribute to source control, CI/CD, automated deployments, release management, environment configuration, monitoring, incident management, and DevSecOps practices.

5+ years of hands-on IBM Datacap experience, including strong experience with IBM Datacap 9.x/9.1.x.
Strong Datacap Studio development experience, along with hands-on Rulerunner administration and development.
Proven experience developing Datacap rulesets, workflows, tasks, actions, and other custom processing components.
Strong understanding of document capture and intelligent document processing, including OCR, classification, extraction, validation, verification, and image processing.
Enterprise-level Datacap administration experience across multiple environments, with strong production troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.
Experience integrating Datacap with databases and enterprise systems, including strong SQL capabilities and REST and/or SOAP integration experience.
Working knowledge of Windows Server and IIS.
Experience participating in Agile application or product development environments, from requirements and design through development, testing, deployment, and production support.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.
Experience with IBM FileNet P8 and IBM Content Navigator is highly preferred.
C#/.NET experience and a background in developing custom Datacap actions or extensions are highly valued.
Experience with Java, JavaScript, SQL Server, Oracle, or DB2 is advantageous.
Familiarity with federal government IT environments, FISMA, NIST, DevSecOps, CI/CD, enterprise application integration, and secure handling of sensitive or PII data is preferred.
Experience building and enhancing new enterprise products, rather than exclusively maintaining legacy applications, is a strong advantage.

Remote work opportunity.
Contract engagement with an enterprise-focused technology environment.
Opportunity to work on a large-scale document-processing product with significant technical scope.
Exposure to IBM Datacap, enterprise integrations, intelligent document processing, and modern DevSecOps practices.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Headless CMS Solutions Architect based in Turkey.

This is a senior, client-facing opportunity focused on designing modern, scalable digital content platforms using headless and composable CMS technologies.

You will lead discovery engagements, translate business and editorial needs into technical solutions, and guide clients through technology evaluation and architecture decisions.

The role combines content strategy, cloud architecture, systems integration, development considerations, security, and enterprise digital transformation.

You will work across platforms including Storyblok, Sanity, Contentful, and Strapi, objectively assessing their capabilities against specific client requirements.

The position also requires a strong understanding of AWS environments and how CMS platforms integrate with cloud-based applications and infrastructure.

You will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and communicate architectural recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

This role is well suited to an experienced architect or consultant who enjoys solving complex digital-content challenges and shaping practical implementation roadmaps.

Lead client discovery workshops, stakeholder interviews, and consulting engagements to understand business, editorial, technical, integration, security, and content requirements.
Gather, analyze, and document current-state requirements and translate them into scalable future-state digital platform architectures.

The position offers the opportunity to build new capabilities while supporting critical enterprise workflows. This is an ideal role for someone who combines deep Datacap expertise with strong software development and problem-solving capabilities.

Accountabilities

Design, develop, configure, enhance, and maintain IBM Datacap applications, including rulesets, tasks, actions, document hierarchies, workflows, validation rules, and verification processes.

Support secure enterprise and federal environments, including practices related to NIST, FISMA, IAM/RBAC, audit logging, vulnerability remediation, application security, PII protection, and configuration management.

Working knowledge of Windows Server and IIS.
Experience participating in Agile application or product development environments, from requirements and design through development, testing, deployment, and production support.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.
Experience with IBM FileNet P8 and IBM Content Navigator is highly preferred.

Experience with Java, JavaScript, SQL Server, Oracle, or DB2 is advantageous.
Familiarity with federal government IT environments, FISMA, NIST, DevSecOps, CI/CD, enterprise application integration, and secure handling of sensitive or PII data is preferred.
Experience building and enhancing new enterprise products, rather than exclusively maintaining legacy applications, is a strong advantage.

You will help transform business requirements into secure, scalable, and reliable technical solutions. Working within an Agile product engineering environment, you will collaborate across development, architecture, testing, and operations. The position offers the opportunity to build new capabilities while supporting critical enterprise workflows. Experience with modern integrations, DevSecOps practices, and secure enterprise environments will be highly valuable. This is an ideal role for someone who combines deep Datacap expertise with strong software development and problem-solving capabilities.

Accountabilities

Design, develop, configure, enhance, and maintain IBM Datacap applications, including rulesets, tasks, actions, document hierarchies, workflows, validation rules, and verification processes.
Configure and optimize OCR, document recognition, classification, data extraction, field validation, image processing, and batch-processing capabilities.
Develop reusable Datacap components and custom actions or extensions, including business rules for document routing, validation, exception handling, and processing.
Install, configure, administer, monitor, and maintain Datacap environments across Development, Test, QA, UAT, and Production.
Administer and troubleshoot Datacap Server, Rulerunner, Datacap Studio, and Datacap Navigator, including processing queues, logs, performance, failed batches, OCR issues, workflow failures, connectivity problems, and production incidents.

Develop and maintain custom components using C#, .NET, Java, JavaScript, SQL, XML, REST, and SOAP, with particular emphasis on C#/.NET for custom Datacap actions and extensions.
Support secure enterprise and federal environments, including practices related to NIST, FISMA, IAM/RBAC, audit logging, vulnerability remediation, application security, PII protection, and configuration management.
Contribute to source control, CI/CD, automated deployments, release management, environment configuration, monitoring, incident management, and DevSecOps practices.

Working knowledge of Windows Server and IIS.
Experience participating in Agile application or product development environments, from requirements and design through development, testing, deployment, and production support.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.

Experience with Java, JavaScript, SQL Server, Oracle, or DB2 is advantageous.
Familiarity with federal government IT environments, FISMA, NIST, DevSecOps, CI/CD, enterprise application integration, and secure handling of sensitive or PII data is preferred.
Experience building and enhancing new enterprise products, rather than exclusively maintaining legacy applications, is a strong advantage.

jobs.title: Senior Requirements Engineer Digital Product, 80-100%
jobs.description:
PEAX bietet eine Lösung für automatisierten Dokumenteneingang, intelligentes Document Processing und Weiterverarbeitung in nachgelagerten Geschäftsprozessen. Damit werden unsere Kunden von administrativem Aufwand befreit und erkennen den Wert ihrer Daten. Wir suchen Menschen, die unsere Produktentwicklung mit analytischer Tiefe und einem ausgeprägten AI-First-Mindset auf das nächste Level bringen.

Aufgaben
Das bewegst du

Du verantwortest das fachliche Herz unseres Produkts: das Domänenmodell. Capabilities, Business Objects, Business Rules und Prozesse hältst du korrekt, widerspruchsfrei und aktuell. Und du sorgst dafür, dass sie über Domänen hinweg zusammenpassen.

Aus vielschichtigen, oft widersprüchlichen Anforderungen machst du klare Struktur: Nachvollziehbare Use Cases, scharf geschnittene Anforderungen und eindeutige Akzeptanzkriterien. Dein wichtigster Beitrag ist dabei nicht, jeden Einzelwunsch zu spezifizieren. Es ist zu erkennen, wann mehrere Einzelfälle dasselbe allgemeine Problem sind, und die allgemeine Lösung durchzusetzen.

Du präzisierst Produktentscheide für die Umsetzung: Regeln, Grenzfälle, Zustände und Sollverhalten. Bei komplexen und domänenübergreifenden Themen führst du die Spezifikation selbst. Im Übrigen setzt du den Standard, nach dem im Team spezifiziert wird, und entwickelst die Modellierungskompetenz deiner Kolleg:innen weiter.

Qualität ist für dich Teil der Spezifikationsarbeit und kein nachgelagerter Schritt. Du erstellst E2E-Testkonzepte und Testfälle für deinen Bereich und prüfst Features. Wir sind ein kleines Team, in dem alle die Qualität des Produkts mittragen.

Du bist für die von dir verantworteten Features die fachliche Ansprechperson für Engineering, Design, Customer Success und Sales sowie für Partner, Reseller und Kunden. Du bist auch die Person, die „so geht das fachlich nicht“ sagen kann und dafür gehört wird.

Deine Arbeit startet in der Product Discovery: Bei der Problemrahmung, nicht erst bei der Übersetzung fertiger Entscheide. Zudem bringst du deine fachliche Sicht in Architekturentscheide ein, wo sie Konsequenzen für das Domänenmodell haben.

PEAX baut gerade agentische Architekturen. Du nutzt AI-Tools strukturiert und verantwortungsvoll als Bestandteil unseres Requirement Engineering Prozesses.

Qualifikation
Das bringst du mit

Mehrjährige Senior-Erfahrung als Requirements Engineer, Business Analyst oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle im B2B-SaaS-Produktumfeld, idealerweise in einer Scale-up-Phase und mit Hintergrund in Document Management, ECM, Workflow-Automatisierung oder einem verwandten Information-Hub-Umfeld. Du hast dabei nachweisbar Verantwortung für fachliche Modelle getragen und nicht nur für Spezifikationsdokumente.

Ausbildungshintergrund in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Business Engineering, BWL mit IT-Affinität (FH, Universität). MSc-Niveau ideal, Bachelor mit entsprechender Senior-Erfahrung ebenfalls möglich.

Echte Modellierungstiefe: Du kannst ein Geschäftsproblem in Entitäten, Zustände, Regeln und Prozesse zerlegen, so dass das Ergebnis widerspruchsfrei ist. Du formulierst Akzeptanzkriterien so, dass sie prüfbar sind. Sicherer Umgang mit BPMN, UML, Use Cases und User Stories sowie mit Jira und Confluence. Kenntnisse in ArchiMate sind ein Pluspunkt.

Generalisierungsinstinkt: Du erkennst, wann mehrere Einzelfälle dasselbe allgemeine Problem sind, und setzt die allgemeine Lösung durch. Du fragst nach dem Problem, bevor du nach der Lösung fragst, und du kannst eine Anforderung auch ablehnen.

Eingehendes Verständnis für administrative Prozesse in KMU, die Aufbereitung von Daten und zur Verfügungstellung via Schnittstellen an Drittanwendungen. Damit zusammenhängend die Fähigkeit, Problemstellen in bestehenden Prozessen zu analysieren und durch intelligente Abläufe zu ersetzen.

Hohe Affinität zu AI-Tools, idealerweise erste Erfahrung mit AI-gestützter Spezifikationsarbeit, Prompt Engineering oder agentischen Systemen aus Produkt-Sicht.

Deutsch auf Muttersprach-Niveau, Englisch verhandlungssicher (C1). Sicheres Auftreten auf C-Level.

Take full, end-to-end ownership of the edge runtime on our smart fridges and Gavetti coffee machine controllers, managing everything from zero-touch provisioning, device bootstrap, call-home and on-device applications.
Drive the consolidation of our fleet management onto a single, reliable platform (such as Azure IoT Hub or KubeEdge), taking charge of making and defending the architectural choices.

YOUR PROFILE

Solid background with roughly 5+ years of experience building and operating production systems, specifically managing a real fleet of devices with live users, outages, and OTA updates.

Design, develop, configure, enhance, and maintain IBM Datacap applications, including rulesets, tasks, actions, document hierarchies, workflows, validation rules, and verification processes.

jobs.title: QA Engineer
jobs.description:
Tu misión en Netquest

Buscamos incorporar a nuestro equipo a un/a Ingeniero/a de QA de nivel intermedio/senior
, con experiencia y una actitud muy proactiva. En este puesto, serás responsable de diseñar, crear y mantener frameworks de automatización de pruebas, identificar riesgos de producto y riesgos técnicos, mejorar nuestra estrategia de testing y trabajar estrechamente con desarrolladores, product managers y equipo de DevOps para prevenir los problemas en lugar de limitarse a detectarlos.

Este puesto es ideal para una persona que se desenvuelva bien en entornos colaborativos, que se anticipe a los retos antes de que surjan y que impulse las buenas prácticas en automatización y estrategias de testing.

Trabajarás en un producto digital de investigación de mercados disponible en tres plataformas: Android, iOS y extensiones de navegador.

¿Qué buscamos en ti?

Tus responsabilidades:

Investigación y reporte de defectos: Identificar, reproducir, investigar y documentar claramente los defectos, incluyendo su impacto, pasos para reproducirlos, logs/evidencias y el contexto técnico (JIRA). Colaborar con los desarrolladores para llevar las incidencias hasta su resolución y evitar que vuelvan a producirse.
Gestión de la cobertura de pruebas:
Revisar de forma proactiva la cobertura de pruebas manuales y automatizadas, identificando y cubriendo cualquier vacío existente.
Estrategia y responsabilidad sobre la automatización:
Definir las estrategias, frameworks y herramientas de automatización para maximizar la cobertura y la eficiencia de las pruebas automatizadas. Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener scripts de automatización robustos, escalables y reutilizables para pruebas de API, UI e integración.
Mejora proactiva de procesos:
Analizar y mejorar los procesos de QA, identificando carencias y proponiendo mejoras antes de que afecten a la calidad del producto, fomentando una cultura de calidad desde las primeras fases del desarrollo.
Colaboración y comunicación transversal:
Participar activamente con product managers, desarrolladores, DevOps y otros stakeholders para asegurar que la calidad esté presente en todas las fases del desarrollo.
CI/CD y fiabilidad de las pruebas:
Configurar y optimizar pipelines de ejecución automatizada de pruebas dentro de entornos CI/CD, garantizando un feedback rápido y resultados fiables y consistentes.

Principales aptitudes y habilidades:

Mentalidad proactiva: con iniciativa y capacidad para anticiparse a los desafíos y actuar antes de que se conviertan en problemas.
Capacidad para liderar con el ejemplo y promover la mejora continua de la calidad.
Capacidad para equilibrar la velocidad de entrega con el nivel de testing adecuado en función del riesgo.
Buenas habilidades de comunicación y capacidad para liderar conversaciones entre equipos y cuestionar decisiones o planteamientos cuando sea necesario.
Capacidad para trabajar de forma independiente manteniendo informados y alineados a los miembros del equipo y a los stakeholders sobre los riesgos y bloqueos relevantes.
Mentalidad analítica y gran atención al detalle.
Disposición para aprender nuevas técnicas y tecnologías.
Nivel de inglés conversacional.

Imprescindibles

Sólidos conocimientos de QA: capacidad para evaluar los riesgos del producto, definir estrategias de testing adecuadas, diseñar casos de prueba efectivos, identificar carencias en la cobertura de pruebas y aplicar enfoques de testing exploratorio y basado en riesgos.
Sólida experiencia en análisis y resolución de defectos: capacidad para reproducir problemas, analizar fallos, analizar la causa y comunicar los defectos de forma clara
Más de 3 años de experiencia en QA/testing, con experiencia práctica en automatización de pruebas.
Sólidos conocimientos de programación/scripting en al menos un lenguaje (Java, Kotlin, TypeScript/JavaScript, etc.).
Experiencia práctica en testing de aplicaciones en Android e iOS, utilizando tanto dispositivos físicos como emuladores/simuladores, incluyendo pruebas de permisos, comportamiento de la aplicación en diferentes condiciones de conectividad y escenarios específicos de cada plataforma.
Experiencia práctica en automatización de pruebas web y/o móviles utilizando herramientas como Playwright, Selenium, Appium o equivalentes
Buen conocimiento del testing de APIs, bases de datos y CI/CD, incluyendo validación de APIs, SQL básico e integración de pruebas automatizadas en pipelines CI/CD.
Buen manejo de Git y de los flujos de trabajo habituales de desarrollo

Se valorará

Experiencia en testing de extensiones de navegador, permisos, compatibilidad entre navegadores y procesos de instalación/actualización.
Experiencia con JIRA, Confluence y Testmo.
Familiaridad con Docker y plataformas cloud como AWS.
Experiencia en pruebas de rendimiento/carga, BDD/Cucumber, accesibilidad, seguridad o pruebas visuales.

¿Qué te ofrecemos en Netquest?

Seguro médico privado de cuadro médico o reembolso (cobertura del 50% a cargo de la empresa).
Plan de retribución flexible: cheques o tarjeta restaurante, transporte y guardería.
Horario laboral flexible: entrada entre las 8:00 y las 10:00, y salida entre las 17:00 y las 19:00. Jornada intensiva los viernes, con salida adelantada entre las 14:00 y las 15:00.
Modelo híbrido de trabajo: 2 días en la oficina y el resto desde casa (teletrabajo).
Fruta fresca y café de calidad siempre disponibles en la oficina.
Entorno colaborativo e enfocado en la innovación. Cultura de aprendizaje continuo y de compartir conocimiento.
Oportunidades para influir en la estrategia y arquitectura de datos a nivel de toda la compañía.

Un equipo diverso para un mundo global

En Netquest, estamos comprometidos con la creación de un entorno de trabajo diverso e inclusivo. Damos la bienvenida a candidaturas de todos los orígenes y experiencias, y no discriminamos por motivos de raza, color, religión, género, orientación sexual, identidad de género, origen nacional, edad, discapacidad o cualquier otra condición protegida por la ley.

¿Quiénes somos?

En Netquest, transformamos el futuro a través de los datos.
Somos líderes globales en soluciones de investigación de mercados. Si te apasiona la innovación y quieres formar parte de un equipo internacional donde el talento y el crecimiento inspiran todo lo que hacemos, ¡te estamos buscando!

jobs.title: Director, Global Software Development
jobs.description:
Director, Global Software Development Job | Straumann Group Careers

Are you ready to unlock your potential? At Straumann Group we’re on an exciting journey of growth, innovation, and impact - driven by our mission to improve oral health and transform millions of lives worldwide. United by purpose, we bring our best selves to work every day, embracing a high-performance, player-learner culture that inspires collaboration, curiosity, and ambition. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to take charge of your own career, harnessing your skills, passion, and enthusiasm for learning to continually grow and progress. Together, we’re not just shaping brighter smiles, we’re unlocking the potential of people everywhere, including our own.

As Director, Global Software Development – Straumann Digital Platform, you will lead the development and delivery of a strategic technology platform at the heart of Straumann’s digital dentistry ecosystem.
You will oversee a distributed software engineering organization and help shape how our teams build, deliver, and operate scalable cloud services, connected workflows, AI-enabled capabilities, integrations, and data-driven products.
Working closely with Product Management, Architecture, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Operations, and other business partners, you will combine technology leadership with delivery execution and people development. A key part of the role will be helping growing engineering teams establish clear structures, effective practices, and the capabilities they need to succeed at scale.

You will:

Lead the end-to-end development and delivery of the Straumann Digital Platform, translating strategy into roadmaps, technical milestones, and measurable outcomes.
Lead and develop distributed engineering teams, creating clear accountability, effective ways of working, and strong collaboration across locations and functions.
Partner with architecture leaders to evolve a secure, modular, scalable, and maintainable platform architecture.
Strengthen engineering practices across cloud development, DevOps, continuous integration and delivery, test automation, observability, API-based integration, and secure-by-design development.
Balance near-term product priorities with long-term platform sustainability, including the active management of technical debt.
Embed quality, cybersecurity, privacy, and regulatory requirements into everyday engineering practices, including relevant medical-device software standards.
Improve delivery predictability, platform reliability, engineering productivity, and operational maturity through meaningful metrics and feedback loops.
Develop engineering managers, technical leaders, and emerging talent while helping build the capabilities required for future growth.
Champion responsible adoption of automation, AI-assisted development, and modern engineering tools.
Communicate progress, risks, dependencies, trade-offs, and investment needs clearly to senior stakeholders.

Essential
Significant experience leading distributed software engineering teams or organizations in a complex environment.
Strong experience with software platforms, cloud-based architectures, enterprise software, or connected digital ecosystems.
Experience working in a regulated or quality-critical environment such as medical devices, healthcare, automotive, aerospace, or financial services.
Practical understanding of modern software engineering approaches, including DevOps, CI/CD, test automation, cybersecurity, cloud operations, and API-based integration.
Experience improving software delivery, quality, collaboration, and engineering effectiveness.
A track record of developing teams, leaders, engineering practices, and organizational capabilities.
Ability to communicate technical decisions and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical senior stakeholders.
Strong business perspective, with the ability to connect technology investments to customer value, scalability, quality, compliance, and lifecycle considerations.
Experience with medical-device software standards such as IEC 62304 or quality systems aligned with ISO 13485.
Experience scaling platform engineering capabilities, AI-enabled development practices, or global software operating models.

What Makes You a Great Fit?

You create clarity when priorities, technologies, and stakeholder needs are complex. You give teams appropriate ownership while establishing clear expectations and accountability.
You are motivated by developing people and helping growing engineering organizations mature. You make decisions transparently, use evidence to guide priorities, and are comfortable balancing delivery speed with quality, security, compliance, and long-term technical sustainability.
You collaborate effectively across functions, cultures, and locations and build trust through clear communication, thoughtful decision-making, and consistent follow-through.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability.

About the Client

Our client is a global technology and communications organisation providing mission-critical digital infrastructure and services to the aviation industry. Its technology supports airlines, airports and other aviation stakeholders across a highly distributed international environment, where reliability, scalability and operational resilience are essential.
As part of a major technology modernisation initiative, the business is evolving its platforms for monitoring, observability, provisioning and configuration management. This role will contribute to that transformation, working with engineering teams across Europe and North America.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled and hands-on Senior System Engineer to contribute to the modernisation of next-generation Datalink observability, monitoring, provisioning and configuration management platforms.
Based in Barcelona and working collaboratively with an international engineering team, you will contribute specialist technical expertise to the definition, architecture, design and implementation of complex software and platform capabilities.
The role requires someone who can operate autonomously, bring proven industry experience to complex technical challenges, and contribute across the full engineering lifecycle from concept and system definition through to production implementation.

Key Responsibilities:

System Engineering
Platform Modernisation
Technical Collaboration
Strategic Outcomes

Contractor Working Arrangement

The engagement is structured around the delivery of defined technical services and project outcomes.
Due to the collaborative and operational nature of the project, the services are expected to include approximately three days per week working from the project site in Barcelona, with the remaining services capable of being delivered remotely where appropriate. The on-site requirement reflects the operational and collaborative needs of the project, including access to relevant teams, technical environments and project activities.
The contractor will retain professional autonomy over the manner in which the services are delivered, subject to agreed project requirements, deliverables, security, confidentiality and site-access arrangements. The engagement is for the provision of specialist technical services and is not intended to create an employment relationship between the contractor and the client.

Required Experience

• 10+ years' experience as a Senior System Engineer, Senior Software Engineer or equivalent technical role within complex software, platform or technology environments.
• Strong experience with observability and monitoring ecosystems, including Grafana Labs technologies such as Alloy, Loki, Mimir or Prometheus, Grafana and OpenTelemetry Protocol (OTLP).
• Proven experience in platform or network system integration, monitoring, configuration management, APIs, microservices and scalable backend systems.
• Strong expertise in software architecture, distributed systems, enterprise application development and modern programming paradigms and frameworks.
• Strong problem-solving capability, with the ability to lead and coordinate technical discussions across complex engineering environments.
• Experience working effectively within international and geographically distributed engineering teams.
• Proven ability to work autonomously, take ownership of technical deliverables and operate effectively with limited day-to-day direction.
• Proficiency in leveraging AI-powered tools to support requirements management, static analysis, test automation, documentation and software engineering activities.

Preferred Experience

• Experience within aviation, telecommunications, networking or other mission-critical technology environments.
• Knowledge of operational support systems, configuration management and service management environments.
• Familiarity with technologies and standards such as ServiceNow.
• Experience with container orchestration and modern observability ecosystems.
• Experience working within globally distributed engineering organisations.
• Hands-on experience integrating AI-powered tools into system definition, architecture, design and development.

jobs.title: Senior IBM Datacap Administrator / Developer
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior IBM Datacap Administrator / Developer based in Spain.

This is a hands-on opportunity for an experienced IBM Datacap professional to contribute to the development and evolution of an enterprise document-processing platform. The role spans Datacap development, platform administration, integrations, troubleshooting, testing, deployment, and production support. You will help transform business requirements into secure, scalable, and reliable technical solutions. Working within an Agile product engineering environment, you will collaborate across development, architecture, testing, and operations. The position offers the opportunity to build new capabilities while supporting critical enterprise workflows. Experience with modern integrations, DevSecOps practices, and secure enterprise environments will be highly valuable. This is an ideal role for someone who combines deep Datacap expertise with strong software development and problem-solving capabilities.

Accountabilities

Design, develop, configure, enhance, and maintain IBM Datacap applications, including rulesets, tasks, actions, document hierarchies, workflows, validation rules, and verification processes.
Configure and optimize OCR, document recognition, classification, data extraction, field validation, image processing, and batch-processing capabilities.
Develop reusable Datacap components and custom actions or extensions, including business rules for document routing, validation, exception handling, and processing.
Install, configure, administer, monitor, and maintain Datacap environments across Development, Test, QA, UAT, and Production.
Administer and troubleshoot Datacap Server, Rulerunner, Datacap Studio, and Datacap Navigator, including processing queues, logs, performance, failed batches, OCR issues, workflow failures, connectivity problems, and production incidents.
Participate throughout the product development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, technical design, sprint planning, development, testing, deployment, release planning, and post-deployment stabilization.
Translate business requirements and user stories into technical solutions, estimate development effort, conduct peer reviews, troubleshoot defects, and implement sustainable fixes.
Develop and support integrations using REST APIs, SOAP web services, databases, file-based interfaces, enterprise content repositories, workflow platforms, and business applications.
Integrate document-processing capabilities with enterprise platforms such as IBM FileNet P8 and IBM Content Navigator where applicable.
Manage metadata mapping, database lookups, document and metadata exports, API data exchange, retries, error handling, audit logging, and exception management.
Develop and maintain custom components using C#, .NET, Java, JavaScript, SQL, XML, REST, and SOAP, with particular emphasis on C#/.NET for custom Datacap actions and extensions.
Support secure enterprise and federal environments, including practices related to NIST, FISMA, IAM/RBAC, audit logging, vulnerability remediation, application security, PII protection, and configuration management.
Contribute to source control, CI/CD, automated deployments, release management, environment configuration, monitoring, incident management, and DevSecOps practices.

Requirements

5+ years of hands-on IBM Datacap experience, including strong experience with IBM Datacap 9.x/9.1.x.
Strong Datacap Studio development experience, along with hands-on Rulerunner administration and development.
Proven experience developing Datacap rulesets, workflows, tasks, actions, and other custom processing components.
Strong understanding of document capture and intelligent document processing, including OCR, classification, extraction, validation, verification, and image processing.
Enterprise-level Datacap administration experience across multiple environments, with strong production troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.
Experience integrating Datacap with databases and enterprise systems, including strong SQL capabilities and REST and/or SOAP integration experience.
Working knowledge of Windows Server and IIS.
Experience participating in Agile application or product development environments, from requirements and design through development, testing, deployment, and production support.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.
Experience with IBM FileNet P8 and IBM Content Navigator is highly preferred.
C#/.NET experience and a background in developing custom Datacap actions or extensions are highly valued.
Experience with Java, JavaScript, SQL Server, Oracle, or DB2 is advantageous.
Familiarity with federal government IT environments, FISMA, NIST, DevSecOps, CI/CD, enterprise application integration, and secure handling of sensitive or PII data is preferred.
Experience building and enhancing new enterprise products, rather than exclusively maintaining legacy applications, is a strong advantage.

Benefits

Remote work opportunity.
Contract engagement with an enterprise-focused technology environment.
Opportunity to work on a large-scale document-processing product with significant technical scope.
Exposure to IBM Datacap, enterprise integrations, intelligent document processing, and modern DevSecOps practices.
Opportunity to contribute across development, architecture, administration, integration, deployment, and production support.
Collaboration within an Agile product engineering environment.
Experience working with enterprise and secure federal technology environments.
Compensation and contract benefits aligned with the engagement and applicable market conditions.

jobs.title: Headless CMS Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Headless CMS Solutions Architect based in Saudi Arabia.

This is a senior, client-facing opportunity focused on designing modern, scalable digital content platforms using headless and composable CMS technologies.

You will lead discovery engagements, translate business and editorial needs into technical solutions, and guide clients through technology evaluation and architecture decisions.

The role combines content strategy, cloud architecture, systems integration, development considerations, security, and enterprise digital transformation.

You will work across platforms including Storyblok, Sanity, Contentful, and Strapi, objectively assessing their capabilities against specific client requirements.

The position also requires a strong understanding of AWS environments and how CMS platforms integrate with cloud-based applications and infrastructure.

You will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and communicate architectural recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

This role is well suited to an experienced architect or consultant who enjoys solving complex digital-content challenges and shaping practical implementation roadmaps.

Accountabilities

Lead client discovery workshops, stakeholder interviews, and consulting engagements to understand business, editorial, technical, integration, security, and content requirements.
Gather, analyze, and document current-state requirements and translate them into scalable future-state digital platform architectures.
Evaluate headless CMS platforms and objectively recommend solutions based on client needs, technical constraints, scalability, and long-term maintainability.
Design scalable content models, schemas, reusable components, taxonomies, metadata structures, and composable content architectures.
Define editorial workflows, approval processes, role-based permissions, localization strategies, and publishing processes.
Design integrations between CMS platforms and enterprise applications, services, APIs, and other digital systems.
Develop architectures for multilingual content, accessibility, technical SEO, search, content governance, and modern web standards.
Design CMS migration strategies for legacy platforms such as Drupal, WordPress, Sitecore, and custom-built systems.
Assess how headless CMS solutions should integrate with AWS-based applications and infrastructure, including services such as S3, CloudFront, Lambda, API Gateway, ECS/EKS, RDS, DynamoDB, OpenSearch, Cognito, IAM, Route 53, WAF, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, and EventBridge.
Collaborate closely with front-end, cloud, DevOps, security, UX, and development teams to ensure architectural decisions can be implemented effectively.
Produce architecture diagrams, technology recommendations, implementation roadmaps, technical documentation, and other solution-design materials.
Present architectural recommendations clearly to executives, business stakeholders, content teams, IT departments, and developers.
Identify technical risks, dependencies, and potential scalability challenges throughout discovery and solution design.
Challenge requirements constructively when simpler, more scalable, or more maintainable approaches are appropriate.
Support implementation planning and ensure proposed solutions align with business objectives and technical realities.

Requirements

Significant professional experience working with headless CMS and composable digital-platform architectures.
Strong hands-on experience with at least two of Storyblok, Sanity, Contentful, or Strapi, with familiarity across the broader platform landscape preferred.
Practical experience with Storyblok features such as Visual Editor, components, workflows, localization, roles and permissions, Content Delivery API, and Management API.
Practical experience with Sanity, including Sanity Studio, structured content, schemas, GROQ, Content Lake, custom editorial experiences, and integrations.
Practical experience with Contentful, including content models, localization, environments, permissions, workflows, Content Delivery API, and Content Management API.
Practical experience with Strapi, including Content Type Builder, components, Dynamic Zones, REST and GraphQL APIs, permissions, plugins, and cloud or self-hosted deployments.
Experience leading CMS or digital-platform discovery and recommending enterprise content-management solutions.
Strong understanding of AWS and cloud-based architecture, with the ability to design solutions and collaborate effectively with cloud and DevOps specialists.
Strong knowledge of REST APIs, GraphQL, webhooks, API integrations, structured content, and composable architecture.
Experience with JavaScript and/or TypeScript and modern front-end frameworks such as React, Next.js, Vue, or Nuxt.
Experience designing enterprise systems integrations and CMS migration strategies.
Strong understanding of content governance, multilingual and localized content, role-based permissions, editorial workflows, technical SEO, accessibility, and modern web standards.
Experience producing architecture diagrams, technical documentation, implementation roadmaps, and technology recommendations.
Strong consulting, communication, facilitation, and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for different audiences.
Comfortable working with executives, business stakeholders, content teams, IT departments, developers, and other technical specialists.
Ability to evaluate technologies objectively, identify risks and dependencies, and communicate architectural trade-offs clearly.
Experience with enterprise search, Digital Asset Management, CRM, LMS, marketing automation, analytics, or identity platforms is an asset.
Additional experience with AWS Solutions Architect certification, CMS certifications, Next.js/React, Node.js, Terraform or Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, DevOps, AWS OpenSearch, Digital Asset Management platforms, CRM, marketing automation, or Learning Management Systems is considered a plus.

Benefits

Fully remote working arrangement.
Opportunity to work on modern headless and composable CMS architectures.

Ben jij een software ontwikkelaar met passie voor innovatie? Wil je bijdragen aan vernieuwende medische oplossingen die het werk van artsen, verpleegkundigen en onderzoekers direct ondersteunen?

Dit ga je doen

Als Software Ontwikkelaar Medische Technologie ga je ontwerpen, ontwikkelen, en testen van softwareoplossingen voor innovatieve medische toepassingen. Je werkt in een multidisciplinair team aan verschillende vraagstukken, waarbij jij verantwoordelijk bent op het gebied van software en productintegratie, binnen een gereguleerde omgeving.

Je Werkzaamheden Bestaan Onder Andere Uit

Ontwikkelen van software voor (prototype) medische hulpmiddelen, onderzoeksopstellingen, en digitale zorgoplossingen.
Rechtstreeks schakelen met eindgebruikers zoals artsen, onderzoekers en zorgprofessionals om hun behoeften te vertalen naar concrete oplossingen.
Samenwerken met collega's uit de disciplines (embedded) software, elektronica, mechanica, en advies MDR.
Vastleggen van ontwerpkeuzes, testresultaten en risicoanalyses conform ISO 13485 en IEC 62304.
Optreden als projectleider in ontwikkelprojecten.
Bijdragen aan het verbeteren van ontwikkelprocessen, kwaliteitssystemen en technische standaarden binnen het team.

Hier ga je werken

Je komt te werken binnen het Team Ontwikkeling van het cluster Medische Technologie & Klinische Fysica van het UMC Utrecht, een bijzondere plek waar technologie, onderzoek en zorg samenkomen. Het multidisciplinaire team bestaat uit ontwerpers op het gebied van mechanica, elektronica, (embedded) software, instrumentmakers en advies rondom MDR. Samen ontwikkelen jullie innovatieve medische technologie, onderzoeksapparatuur en maatwerkoplossingen voor de zorg.

De cultuur is professioneel maar informeel: er is ruimte voor creativiteit en een sterke focus op het leveren van de juiste kwaliteit, passend bij elke unieke vraag. Je werkt nauw samen met onderzoekers, artsen en zorgprofessionals en ziet daardoor direct de impact van jouw werk in de praktijk.

Dit neem je mee

Je neemt graag verantwoordelijkheid, houdt van uitdaging en krijgt energie van samenwerken aan innovatieve oplossingen. Je werkt zelfstandig en proactief, maar bent ook een echte teamspeler die verschillende technische disciplines weet te verbinden en collega’s enthousiast maakt. Met jouw communicatieve vaardigheden, oog voor kwaliteit en drive om continu te verbeteren, draag je bij aan slimme oplossingen én een sterk eindresultaat.

Wat breng je mee?

Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding in Informatica, Software Engineering of een vergelijkbare richting.
Ongeveer 3 tot 5 jaar ervaring als softwareontwikkelaar, of in een vergelijkbare functie.
Bij voorkeur ervaring binnen een gereguleerde omgeving, zoals medische technologie of de industrie.
Goede kennis van Python en C#.
Ervaring met DevOps-principes en versiebeheer met Git.

Een Pré Als Je Ook Ervaring Hebt Met

Het coördineren van projecten of begeleiden van technische ontwikkeltrajecten.
Kwaliteits- en ontwikkelstandaarden zoals ISO 13485 en IEC 62304.
Medische instrumentatie, signaalverwerking of high-frequency waveform-analyse.
Interoperabiliteitsstandaarden, zoals SDC (Service-Oriented Device Connectivity).

Een mooie uitdaging voor een professional die techniek, innovatie én maatschappelijke impact wil combineren.

Eindejaarsuitkering van 8,3% en vakantietoeslag van 8%.

Als Medior Support Engineer werk je nog steeds mee in de dagelijkse 1e- en 2e-lijns support, maar pak je daarnaast steeds vaker complexere technische vraagstukken op. Je leert verschillende klantomgevingen kennen, werkt met Microsoft-, server- en netwerktechnologie en groeit stap voor stap naar meer technische verantwoordelijkheid. Op termijn kun je je verder ontwikkelen richting bijvoorbeeld security, monitoring of System Engineer.

Je zorgt eerst dat de klant verder kan, maar kijkt daarna vooral naar de oorzaak. Waarom gebeurt dit en hoe zorgen we ervoor dat het niet opnieuw voorkomt? Juist die technische diepgang maakt deze functie anders dan een reguliere servicedeskrol.

Daarnaast ben je een belangrijke vraagbaak voor je collega’s. Wanneer zij technisch vastlopen, kunnen ze bij jou terecht om te sparren en samen tot een oplossing te komen. Om deze rol goed te vervullen, houd jij je dagelijks bezig met:

Analyseren en oplossen van complexere incidenten binnen server-, cloud- en netwerkomgevingen
Werken met onder andere Microsoft 365, Azure, Intune, Active Directory en Windows Server

Ondersteunen van eerste- en tweedelijns collega’s bij technische escalaties

Waar je terecht komt

Je komt terecht op de servicedesk van Collabite, een MSP die IT-omgevingen beheert voor verschillende organisaties. Daardoor werk je niet iedere dag in dezelfde omgeving, maar krijg je te maken met verschillende klanten, infrastructuren en technische vraagstukken.

Het serviceteam bestaat momenteel uit ongeveer elf collega's en groeit verder. Het is een relatief jong team waarin samenwerken belangrijk is. Heb jij ruimte en zie je dat een collega vastloopt? Dan help je elkaar. Tegelijkertijd is de afdeling volop in ontwikkeling. Collabite gaat de verdeling tussen eenvoudige en complexe tickets verder aanscherpen. Jij krijgt daarin juist de complexere vraagstukken en kunt vanuit jouw technische kennis meedenken over hoe processen slimmer kunnen worden ingericht.

Wil je jezelf verder specialiseren? Dan zijn er mogelijkheden richting bijvoorbeeld security, monitoring of uiteindelijk System Engineer.

Wie jij bent

Jij vindt het leuk om een technisch probleem echt uit te zoeken. Een tijdelijke oplossing is soms nodig, maar je wilt vooral begrijpen waarom iets gebeurt en hoe je herhaling voorkomt. Daarnaast breng je het volgende mee:

Ervaring binnen IT-support, systeembeheer of een vergelijkbare technische functie

Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal

Über T-Systems International GmbH

Bei T-Systems bieten wir unseren Geschäftskunden die richtigen Systemlösungen für ihr digitales Business. Mit unserem Portfolio stellen wir sicher, dass digitale Transformation Komplexität reduziert, Kosten einspart und die alltägliche Arbeit erleichtert. Unsere Schwerpunkte sind Konnektivität, Digital, Cloud & Infrastruktur sowie Sicherheit - Let's power higher performance!

Die Unit Cloud Services agiert auf nationaler und internationaler Ebene für mittelständische und große Unternehmen. Wir entwickeln, vermarkten und betreiben agile, cloud-native, zukunftsorientierte Produkte und Services für die digitale Welt. Wir verstehen uns als Innovationstreiber und machen das Geschäft unserer Kunden fit für die digitale Zukunft. Unsere Mission: Gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden gestalten wir die sicherste, einfachste und effizienteste Transformation in eine digitalisierte und cloud-native Zukunft.

Dein Bereich

Wir betreiben T Cloud Public! T Cloud Public ist Europas #1 Cloud Provider, ein Cloud-Standardprodukt auf Basis von Open-Source-Community-Software und angetrieben durch die Prinzipien von DevSecOps. Schlanke Strukturen, agile Methoden, hochmotivierte Teams und ein äußerst dynamisches Geschäftsumfeld bestimmen unser Handeln. Mit dieser kundenorientierten und agilen Ausrichtung sind wir der Ankerpunkt für das Public-Cloud-Geschäft in der Deutschen Telekom Gruppe.

Wir werden daran gemessen, eine sichere, stabile und innovative Plattform bereitzustellen. Gemeinsam mit unserem Plattformpartner und weiteren Partnern aus dem OpenStack-Ökosystem arbeiten wir daran, ein hochinnovatives Public-Cloud-Produkt auf Basis europäischer Sicherheits- und Datenschutzstandards zu schaffen.

Wir suchen Menschen, die Profis und Evangelisten mit großer Begeisterung für Cloud-Technologie sind und sich den Herausforderungen stellen, die durch die Entwicklung und den Betrieb einer Hyperscale-Public-Cloud entstehen.

Wir bieten einzigartige Einblicke darin, wie eine große Public Cloud unter der Haube funktioniert, interkulturelle Teamarbeit, flache Hierarchien und einen eigenständigen Arbeitsstil.

Deine Aufgaben

Als Architect verstehst du die neuesten Entwicklungen in der Cloud- und Container-Technologie. Kundenorientiert entwickelst und erweiterst du die Plattform unserer Open Telekom Cloud.

Du möchtest:

Die Plattformarchitektur verbessern und dabei IT-Sicherheit ernst nehmen.
Vertiefte Kenntnisse im Bereich Hardware Security Modules wären von Vorteil.
Innovative Plattform- und Software-as-a-Service-Features entwerfen und entwickeln.
Als vertrauenswürdige:r Berater:in für OpenStack-basierte Public-Cloud-Technologie agieren.
Praktisch an der Konsole arbeiten, um deine Architekturarbeit zu untermauern.
Konsequente Automatisierung mit gängigen Automatisierungsframeworks vorantreiben.
In einem Team von Spezialist:innen arbeiten, in dem sich alle gegenseitig offen und vertrauensvoll unterstützen.

Dein Profil

Abgeschlossenes Studium in einem technischen, ingenieurwissenschaftlichen oder naturwissenschaftlichen Fach oder vergleichbare Berufsausbildung.
5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der IT mit Schwerpunkt auf modernen Cloud-Technologien.
Sehr gute Kenntnisse von Software-, Cloud- und Container-Architekturen.
Erfahrung in der Infrastrukturautomatisierung.
Fundierte Kenntnisse in Linux, Systemtools und netzwerkbezogenen Services.
Ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung.
Kenntnisse agiler Entwicklungsprozesse.
Mentoring- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten.
Fähigkeit, technische Lösungen zu bewerten und kreative Ansätze zu entwickeln.
OpenStack- und Programmiererfahrung in Open-Source-Projekten sind von Vorteil.
Sehr gute schriftliche und mündliche Englisch- oder Deutschkenntnisse.
Du arbeitest innerhalb der Europäischen Union, um die Anforderungen unserer Kunden an Datensicherheit und Datenschutz zu erfüllen.

Was wir bieten

Flexible Arbeitsmodelle:
Gestalte deinen Arbeitsalltag flexibel mit Gleitzeit und der Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten, um Berufs- und Privatleben optimal zu vereinbaren.

Attraktives Gehaltspaket:
Profitiere von einer wettbewerbsfähigen Vergütung, einer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge und weiteren Sozialleistungen.

Individuelle Entwicklung:
Wir fördern deine Karriere durch vielfältige Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, Zertifizierungen (insbesondere in Cloud-Technologien und Architektur), Konferenzen und interne Entwicklungsprogramme.

Innovation und Technologie:
Arbeite an vorderster Front mit modernsten Cloud-Technologien (Public Cloud, Kubernetes, IaC) und gestalte aktiv die digitale Zukunft mit.

Teamgeist und Kollegialität:
Eine offene und wertschätzende Unternehmenskultur, in der Zusammenarbeit, Wissensaustausch und gegenseitige Unterstützung großgeschrieben werden.

Work-Life-Balance:
Genieße 30 Tage Urlaub, umfassende Gesundheitsangebote und Programme zur Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Familie.

Moderne Arbeitsumgebung:
Ausgestattet mit State-of-the-Art-Equipment und inspirierenden Arbeitsplätzen in unseren Büros oder komfortables mobiles Arbeiten.

new_jobs.title: Mathematisch-technischer Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
🚀 Mathematisch-technischer Software Engineer (m/w/d)
Automation · Scientific Software · Measurement Systems
📍 Paderborn · garage33
💰 3.000 € brutto/Monat
🕒 Vollzeit
📅 Start: ab sofort
Über EASY Photonics
EASY Photonics ist ein junges Deep-Tech-Startup aus Paderborn.
Wir entwickeln ein kompaktes Multisensorsystem für die automatisierte Analyse von Flüssigkeiten – zunächst für Wasser- und Umweltanwendungen. Unser Ziel ist, komplexe Messungen stärker zu automatisieren und direkt dort verfügbar zu machen, wo die Proben entstehen, z. B. in Kläranlagen, industriellen Prozessen oder wissenschaftlichen Messkampagnen.
Aktuell überführen wir unseren Forschungsdemonstrator in ein robustes, reproduzierbar herstellbares Produkt und bauen gleichzeitig Geräte-, Mess- und Laborautomation auf.
Dafür suchen wir einen Mathematisch-technischen Software Engineer (m/w/d).
Deine Rolle
Du entwickelst Software dort, wo sie auf reale Hardware trifft.
Der Schwerpunkt liegt auf Automation und produktnaher Software:
Steuerung kartesischer Robotersysteme
automatisierte Probenvorbereitung und Pipettierung
Ansteuerung von Motoren, Pumpen, Ventilen und Sensoren
automatisierte Messabläufe
Kommunikation zwischen Messgeräten und Automation
Ablauf- und Zustandssteuerungen
Fehlererkennung, Logging und Diagnose
Prüf- und Kalibrierabläufe
Geräte- und Konfigurationsmanagement
strukturierte Speicherung und Zuordnung von Messdaten
Benutzeroberflächen und Schnittstellen

Je nach Projekt und Interesse können auch Scientific Data Visualization, Dashboards oder georeferenzierte Messdaten Teil deiner Arbeit werden. Der Schwerpunkt bleibt aber klar auf Softwareentwicklung und Automation.
Du bist nicht unser „einziger Entwickler“
Wir bauen gerade ein wachsendes technisches Team auf.
Du arbeitest eng zusammen mit:
einem weiteren Software Engineer, der insbesondere an KI-gestützter Auswertung und Datenfusion arbeitet
einem Product & Automation Design Engineer, der die mechanische Seite unserer Geräte, Robotik und Automation entwickelt
unserem Gründer und der technischen Systementwicklung

Zusätzlich erhalten wir Entwicklungsunterstützung durch Innowise sowie das Jülich Supercomputing Centre (JSC).
Du musst also nicht gleichzeitig Embedded Developer, Frontend-Entwickler, KI-Spezialist, Data Scientist und Maschinenbauer sein.
Wie wir Automation entwickeln
Wir wollen nicht für jedes Problem eine teure fertige Industrieanlage einkaufen.
Viele Systeme entwickeln wir selbst – unter anderem mit kartesischen Achssystemen auf Basis moderner 3D-Drucker-Mechanik, Standardmotoren, Sensoren, Kameras und eigener Hardware.
Der Maschinenkonstrukteur entwickelt beispielsweise die Mechanik eines Pipettierroboters – du entwickelst die Software, mit der daraus ein funktionierendes Automatisierungssystem wird.
Was du mitbringen solltest
Für die Einstufung im öffentlich geförderten Projekt benötigen wir einen abgeschlossenen Master- oder Diplomabschluss, z. B. in:
Informatik
Technischer Informatik
Software Engineering
Scientific Computing
Mathematik mit Informatikschwerpunkt
Computational Science
Embedded Systems
Automatisierungstechnik mit starkem Softwareanteil
oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung

Du solltest:
sehr gut programmieren können
analytisch und strukturiert denken
Interesse an mathematisch-technischen Problemen haben
keine Scheu vor realer Hardware haben
dich selbstständig in neue technische Systeme einarbeiten können
auch mit noch nicht vollständig definierten Anforderungen umgehen können

Berufserfahrung ist willkommen, aber keine Voraussetzung.
Eigene Projekte, wissenschaftliche Software, Robotik, Embedded-Systeme, Open-Source-Beiträge oder eine technisch interessante Masterarbeit sind für uns besonders interessant.
Technologien können z. B. Python, C/C++, C#, Rust, Git, Linux, Mikrocontroller, Gerätekommunikation, Datenbanken oder Computer Vision umfassen. Du musst nicht alles davon beherrschen.
Wie wir arbeiten
Eine typische Aufgabe könnte lauten:
„Unser Pipettierroboter soll diese Proben automatisch vorbereiten und anschließend die Messung starten.“
Dann konkretisieren wir gemeinsam die Anforderungen und setzen die Lösung praktisch um:
programmieren → an echter Hardware testen → Fehler finden → verbessern → erneut testen
Wenn dir diese Art von Softwareentwicklung Spaß macht, passt die Stelle gut zu dir.
Dein Arbeitsplatz
Wir arbeiten in der garage33 in Paderborn. Dort haben wir umfangreiche Möglichkeiten für Prototyping und Fertigung und bauen einen großen Teil unserer Messgeräte und Automation direkt vor Ort auf.
Softwareentwicklung findet bei uns deshalb nicht losgelöst von der Hardware statt.
Was wir bieten
3.000 € brutto pro Monat
Vollzeit, Start ab sofort
Arbeit in einem wachsenden Deep-Tech-Team
viel technischer Gestaltungsspielraum
direkter Kontakt zu Robotik und wissenschaftlicher Messtechnik
kurze Entscheidungswege
eigene technische Verantwortung
Möglichkeit, unsere Software- und Automatisierungsarchitektur früh mitzuprägen
Entwicklungsumgebung in der garage33
Finanzierung der Stelle im Rahmen von Grüne Gründungen.NRW

Interesse?
Dann schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und gerne Beispiele deiner bisherigen Projekte, z. B. GitHub, wissenschaftliche Software, Robotikprojekte oder deine Masterarbeit.
Wir suchen nicht den längsten Lebenslauf, sondern jemanden, der sehr gut denken und programmieren kann und Lust hat, gemeinsam mit einem technischen Team reale Maschinen und wissenschaftliche Messgeräte zu entwickeln.

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
C# Developer / Software Engineer

£70,000 to £75,000

Working pattern: Hybrid. x3 days in Office

Location: London

Benefits: Pension up to 17%, Bonus, 34 days holiday + a heap of flexible benefits.

A global business is hiring a C# Developer to take hands-on technical ownership inside one of its core platform teams.

The platform is cloud-based, .NET throughout, and carries real weight: secure services for end users, internal case management, client reporting, and live integrations out to third-party financial systems. It is growing, and they want someone senior enough to shape how it grows rather than just add to it.

What you would be running:
Significant slices of the platform, yours from the first design conversation through to the release note and whatever comes back afterwards.
The judgement call on technical debt in a mature C# codebase: what is genuinely holding the platform back, what is cosmetic, and what the team should spend its next quarter on.
Larger refactoring and re-architecture work when the answer is that the current shape will not carry where the product is going.
The data layer as the platform scales, including the integrations that reach outside it.
Whether problems surface on your terms or the user's, through the monitoring, logging and alerting you put around what you build.
How releases go out and what happens when one does not behave.
The engineering standard around you, set through code review, mentoring and the example your own work sets.
AI-assisted tooling used with your name still on the output, which they have been deliberate about wanting rather than quietly tolerating.

What they need from you:
Deep commercial C# on a .NET codebase you stayed with long enough to know its history. .NET 8 or later ideally, though what you did with it matters more than the version number.
Ownership of live software: releases you planned, incidents you investigated, production problems you fixed at 6pm on a Friday.
Performance work with evidence behind it, across both the C# and the data layer, using Entity Framework or EF Core against SQL Server and Azure SQL.

new_jobs.description:
Our product helps security teams quickly and accurately detect intrusions in their cloud environment using canaries - decoy tripwires deployed to deceive attackers.

We're at a massive inflection point and this is a hugely exciting time to join the company:

We've just raised a $20m Series A led by FirstMark with Accel, MMC, Tapestry and CCL.
We doubled ARR last quarter, work with companies like Riot Games, Docker and Snyk, and have grown from 5 people to 26 in 18 months.
Our research recently helped fix a P1 security flaw in Google's Gemini CLI.

We’re Looking For Someone Who…

Is genuinely interested in technology and cyber security, and keen to build a career in it.
Has a strong academic foundation - an undergraduate or/and master's degree, ideally in a STEM subject like computer science, engineering, maths, physics… and has demonstrated real academic excellence.
Has strong engineering fundamentals and a real appetite to learn - can write clean, correct code in a known language, and is genuinely curious about how things work under the hood.
Has built things they're proud of - side projects, open source, hackathons… And is excited by the pace and rate of change that is inevitable in any successful, early stage startup.
Gets their energy from getting things done and in the hands of customers but is also here to have fun along the way!

If you don’t fit this bill exactly but think you could make a difference here - please, apply!

Role

Reporting to Niall, our Engineering Lead, and with significant exposure to our CTO and Co-Founder, Sam, you’ll join a team of other awesome engineers looking to make their mark on the world.

This Includes

Working face to face with both founders, the whole engineering team and our customers and prospects to build a delightful product that solves real problems.
Working across the stack, mostly in C# on .NET Core 10 (here's why), but also Terraform and building out our frontend in HTMX.
All the good practices you’d expect from technical co-founders who’ve done this before (CD, Infrastructure as code, simple but scalable and powerful architecture)
We’re a small, tight team with demanding customers so expect to be shipping every day with very little bureaucracy.
We actively encourage AI-assisted development and give every engineer full access to tools like Claude and Codex.
We’re based in a Central London office and work here 5 days a week (and everyone we hire will too).

FAQs

How is work organised at Tracebit?

It’s a small, tight team - we have a standup everyday, each team member is usually responsible for delivering something reasonably large for customers and we meet every few weeks to talk about longer term plans. Between that - there’s a tonne of discussions, customer feedback and analysis, but not a huge amount of process, the team is trusted to prioritise where to spend their time.

Where is the office?

The whole team works together in an office right next to Warren Street tube station - there are lots of great places to grab lunch nearby.

Are you doing hybrid/remote?

‍Short answer: No, but flexible on a day to day basis.

Long answer: We are set on building the company on a foundation of an office based culture. We are a very early stage company and think that we’ll build the best company at the fastest pace we can whilst also having a lot of fun by physically working together 5 days a week. On a case by case basis (e.g. leaving early for a holiday, staying home for a builder, working remote for a few days to visit family, etc. etc.) we’re very reasonable and flexible. We respect that this is not for everyone.

‍ What are the working hours like?

‍We think 9am-6pm will bring a great cadence to work. As a Founding Engineer there will definitely be times you need to pick up work outside of these hours, we’re keen to limit this where we can but also offer flexibility in return.

Can you sponsor visas?

We can support various types of working visas in the UK, including:

Skilled Worker Visa (both from within and outside the UK)
Intra-Company Transfer Visa
Graduate Visa Transition

We are keen to support candidates who require visa sponsorship. Please let us know which specific visa type you might need during the initial application or interview process. Our team is committed to helping talented individuals navigate the necessary visa requirements.
